card.name: Small prepositions in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as OF, IN and FOR in ALL-CAPS label text, right before THE or a patient group. Seen in boxed warnings and similar capitalized passages.

modes.label: OF before THE
modes.description: The word OF in capitalized text, leading into a noun phrase starting with THE.
modes.example: THE USE OF DRUGS<< OF>> THE TETRACYCLINE CLASS

modes.label: IN before patients
modes.description: The word IN in capitalized text, leading into a patient group or body site.
modes.example: THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR<< IN>> INDIVIDUALS WITH A HISTORY

modes.label: FOR before patients
modes.description: The word FOR in capitalized text, leading into patient-related terms.
modes.example: ALL DOSES MUST BE INDIVIDUALIZED<< FOR>> PATIENTS’ RENAL FUNCTION

card.writes: It suppresses sentence-starting words like The, Your and Our, so the next word is less likely to be a capitalized sentence opener.
card.plain: It fires on little words like of, in and for inside shouted all-caps warning text.
